book.title: Cambridge International AS & A Level Mathematics: Probability & Statistics 1
book.author: Dean Chalmers
book.policy: Book supplies sequence and methods; notes, examples and quick checks are independently written. No book exercises or artwork are reproduced.

syllabus.version_note: Official live PDF cover says Version 5, while its changes page still says Version 4. No publication date for Version 5 asserted. Section 5.1 checked directly.

conventions.raw_quartiles: Median of each half, excluding the overall median if n is odd. For sizes 4r+3 this gives integer quartile ranks. Explicitly stated where needed.
conventions.grouped_quantiles: Graph estimates; reference answers use straight-line interpolation between boundary-cumulative pairs. Sensible plotted curves/readings are accepted.
conventions.variance: Population variance: divide by n, not n-1.
conventions.boxplot_whiskers: Minimum and maximum, including outliers unless explicitly stated otherwise.
conventions.precision: Retain full precision in intermediate calculations; numerical estimates to 3 significant figures unless otherwise specified.

sourceCheckSpecifications: Retained privately as specifications only. Written diagrams, explanations and graphical estimates use the existing manual/teacher workflow. Full method marks are not awarded for a numerical final answer.
